scope: Generic opt-in three-pool combat-cost and target-pool damage runtime. Individual combat commands remain separately gated.
costAdjustment: baseCost * multiplier - (((governingAttribute - 300) / 1200) * (baseCost * multiplier)), clamped to zero and truncated to an integer

regenerationAuthority.boundary: This combat-HAM contract owns atomic costs, pool damage, incapacitation, and recapacitation. The nine-attribute runtime owns primary-pool regeneration governors, posture multipliers, player/non-player combat eligibility, and direct incapacitated/dead suppression.

profiledCreatureWeaponFixture.familyPolicy: Every generated creature carrying precu.combatProfile and an object/weapon/creature/* strength-band weapon inherits the pinned Core3 creature-default zero-cost vector.

knownLimitations.commandActivation: Production overrides are limited to the authenticated Marksman tier-I headShot1, bodyShot1, and legShot1 matrix. Every additional command remains separately gated.
knownLimitations.weaponCoverage: Pinned CDEF rifle, pistol, and carbine 10/15/10 fixtures cover the authenticated Marksman tier-I matrix. Generated PRE-CU creature-profile weapons use the pinned Core3 creature-default 0/0/0 vector; additional player weapon templates require provenance before activation.
knownLimitations.woundsAndBattleFatigue: Wounds, battle fatigue, healing balance, deathblow, and cloning remain later M3 work. PRE-CU posture-specific regeneration is implemented by the nine-attribute runtime and is not deferred here.
knownLimitations.statMigrationUi: The nine-value stat-migration message is wire-ready, but the Publish 14 client mediator remains a separate restoration slice.

buildEvidence.evidenceState: The canonical zero-class Java/x64 deployment is authenticated through the nine-attribute Build verifier, including exact combat.class, CreatureObject.cpp.o, libserverGame.a, SwgGameServer, all fifteen live mappings, and clean post-start logs.
